g.text: An AI model reads every email, writes a summary and decides keep or
junk. Best search results, slowest: one AI call per email.
★ a scan of this mailbox recommends this one
(free ones first, so the AI only sees what is left)
2. check message lengths to set how text is split
3. AI tries the junk rules on a sample, you check it
4. AI reads each email: a summary, and keep or junk
5. put the junk on a skip list
7. keep the attachments so agents can open them
No AI model running? Choose the first recipe.
